name: Aroha Kōtare
bio:
Aroha's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with electronics and a deep-seated love for speed. Growing up in Auckland, she spent countless hours tinkering with circuits and building her own remote-controlled cars, often racing them against friends in the local park. This passion led her to pursue a degree in Electrical Engineering, where she excelled in signal processing and control systems.

After graduating, Aroha gained valuable experience in the aerospace industry, working on complex avionics systems. However, her heart remained set on motorsport. She eventually made the leap, joining a smaller racing team before being scouted by Red Bull Racing for her innovative approach to electronic systems and her ability to troubleshoot complex problems under pressure. Aroha is known for her 'big picture' thinking, always looking for ways to improve overall car performance through electronics integration, not just individual component optimization. Her relentless pursuit of efficiency and reliability makes her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail, with a few strands escaping to frame her face.
physical.description: Aroha is of average height, with a focused and determined expression.

quirks: Constantly sketches circuit diagrams on napkins during meetings.
Has a collection of vintage multimeters on her desk.
Always listens to Māori music through noise-canceling headphones while working, claiming it helps her focus.
